title: Skew-Symmetric Factor Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28301v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The paper introduces and analyzes a factor model for (real) skew-symmetric data, which arise naturally in directed flows and in pairwise comparisons used for rankings. Working within a signal-plus-noise framework, we analyze spectral inference and establish a BBP-type phase transition in signal strength. Under Gaussian noise, we derive joint eigenvalue fluctuation limits. Above the separation threshold, the estimated signal strength is asymptotically normal whenever the population strength has multiplicity one. For a general multiplicity $k$, the joint limiting fluctuations of the corresponding sample eigenvalues above the threshold are given by the eigenvalues of a scaled $k\times k$ Gaussian unitary ensemble matrix. The skew-symmetric structure induces paired eigenspaces, and we characterize the canonical angles between the population and sample eigenspaces. Below the threshold, the corresponding largest sample eigenvalue converges t

translated_abstract: 本文引入并分析了一种针对（实）反对称数据的因子模型，这类数据自然出现在有向流以及用于排名的两两比较中。在信号加噪声的框架下，我们分析了谱推断方法，并在信号强度上建立了BBP型相变。在高斯噪声下，我们推导了联合特征值波动的极限。在分离阈值之上，只要总体强度具有单重特征值，估计出的信号强度即为渐近正态。对于一般的重数 $k$，阈值之上相应样本特征值的联合极限波动由一个缩放的 $k\times k$ 高斯酉系综矩阵的特征值给出。反对称结构会诱导出成对的特征空间，我们刻画了总体特征空间与样本特征空间之间的典范角。在阈值之下，相应的最大样本特征值收敛到……
tldr: 本文提出了针对反对称数据（如双向流量比较）的因子模型，建立了信号强度的BBP型相变，并给出了样本特征值的联合波动极限以及总体与样本特征空间之间典范角的刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces factor models for skew-symmetric data, establishes a BBP-type phase transition in signal strength, and derives joint eigenvalue fluctuation limits along with characterizations of principal angles between population and sample eigenspaces.
